recognize_zh: 中央一顆中性球的細胞質被一團均質、無結構、紫紅色的圓形包涵體（hematoxylin body，變性核物質）佔滿，把分葉核擠壓成新月形貼在邊緣，這是 LE 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Single neutrophil containing a large, round, homogeneous magenta-purple inclusion filling most of the cytoplasm
Inclusion is smooth and glassy with no chromatin texture (phagocytosed denatured nuclear material, hematoxylin body)
Neutrophil nuclear lobes compressed and displaced to the periphery as crescentic fragments
Thin rim of pale cytoplasm around the ingested mass
Background of densely packed, overlapping red cells consistent with a buffy coat/thick preparation
describe_en: Buffy coat preparation of whole blood shows a neutrophil whose cytoplasm is occupied by a large, round, homogeneous, glassy purple inclusion lacking chromatin structure. The neutrophil's own nuclear lobes are pushed to the periphery and wrap around the ingested material. The background consists of crowded red cells. Findings are consistent with an LE cell (neutrophil that has phagocytosed antibody-opsonized denatured nuclear material), supportive of systemic lupus erythematosus in the appropriate serologic context (ANA and anti-dsDNA positive).

ddx.vs: A tart cell contains an ingested intact nucleus that retains chromatin pattern and often a rim of cytoplasm, whereas the LE body is structureless and homogeneous.
Apoptotic bodies are usually smaller, dense and pyknotic or fragmented rather than a single large, pale-to-magenta homogeneous mass.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with ingested red cell or cryoglobulin
ddx.vs: Ingested red cells are pink-orange like surrounding erythrocytes and cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue and often multiple, unlike the purple hematoxylin body.
